collection.title: Toyota Noah/Voxy 2014 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Noah/Voxy Roadster 2014 to 2017 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side anda 16" the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
